# dsh-reasoning-effort-slider
English | 中文
Turns the **Effort row** of DeepSeek Harness's model menu into a **Codex-style reasoning-effort slid
the **Effort row** of DeepSeek Harness's model menu into a **Codex-style reasoning-effort slider**:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Nothing is added to the composer tool row. The collapsed model seat keeps the native
`model · effort
⌄` typography; only that effort text is tinted.
## Interaction
| Action | Behaviour |

| Press on the track | Jumps to the pressed cell |
| Drag | The knob **follows the pointer**: knob a
nd fill track the cursor, while the level name, ticks and writes use the nearest level; on release i

t snaps onto the cell in 80 ms, without bounce |
| Release | Commits immediately (resting the pointe

r for ~160 ms also commits) |
| `←` `→` `↑` `↓` | One level per press, committed immediately |
| `Ho

me` / `End` | Lowest / highest level |
| Hover | Tooltip with the current level and “further right c

t / highest level |
| Hover | Tooltip with the current level and “further right costs more tokens” |

Writes are deduplicated and coalesced: a drag commits at most a few times, and picking the level
alr
eady in effect writes **nothing**. A failure shows its reason under the track and clears after 4 s.
## Colour and effects (driven by level position, independent of level count)
| Position | Fill right end | Starfield | Level text |

| First level | blue `#4d93f8` | none | native (an `Off` level is never tinted) |
| Middle | blue →

violet `#9333ea` | none | blue → indigo |
| Highest | deep violet `#4c1d95` | 26 staggered stars + v
iolet nova layer | violet `#8b5cf6` |

- The fill is `linear-gradient(90deg, blue → colour at the current position)`: always blue on the
le

ft, deepening to the right.
- The nova layer and the starfield are **clipped to the filled part**, s

o nothing glows to the
right of the knob.
- The knob is a white circle as tall as the track (28 px)

whose centre is inset by 14 px, so it
stays a full circle at both ends.
## Why it cannot break the native menu

- It only adds a `data-dres-row` attribute to the native effort row (taller, wrapping). Native
class

es, copy and chevron are untouched.
- Anything unexpected is **fail-open**: no `aria-controls` on th

e trigger, a menu that is not the
model/effort pair, or a row outside this composer card means “do n

ot inject” — the native menu
keeps working.
- Growing that row triggers the menu's own `ResizeObserv

er`, which re-measures and clamps the panel
back on screen.
- On close or unload the container is re

moved, the attribute dropped, and every tinted text colour
restored.
## Data path (native public surface only)
| Purpose | API |

| Read levels | `session.modelCatalog()` → `groups[].models[].reasoning.efforts` |
| Read current va
lue | the `modelSelection` session projection (`useProjection`), falling back to the catalog default

|
| Write level | `session.selectModel({ sessionId, provider, model, reasoningEffort })` — the same
entry the native menu uses |

## Compatibility

The supported host range is declared in `package.json` as `engines.dsh`:
**DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-
0`**, verified against `0.2.1-rc.2`.

DSH checks that range before loading a plugin. A host release outside it is refused with an
explicit
incompatibility message instead of leaving a slider that silently never appears.
## Known limits

- **Depends on the native menu's semantic structure** (`aria-haspopup` / `aria-expanded` /
`aria-con

trols`, two root rows with `role="menuitem"`). If a host release changes it, the plugin
silently doe

s nothing — it never breaks the menu — and needs a follow-up.
- The model menu has to be open to cha

nge the level; nothing is shown in the composer tool row.
- A model that advertises a single level (

for example with thinking disabled) renders no control,
and the native row keeps its original height

(`setActive` drops the growth).
- The model catalog is cached for the page lifetime (a reconnect re

fetches it). Providers or models
added in Settings need one page reload.
- The selection applies to

the **next request**; a running step keeps the level it started with
(same as the native menu).
## Feedback

- **Bugs and feature requests** — open an issue. The template asks for the
plugin and DSH versions;

that pair is usually the whole diagnosis.
- **Setup help, custom model profiles, "does this work wit

h X"** — email
**nupotecrosstvo@gmail.com**.
- **Security** — email the same address instead of open

ing a public issue; see
SECURITY.md.
- **Quick questions / build logs** — @nupote_ on X.
